name: National Defense University
zh: 中国人民解放军国防大学
aliases: National Defence University of the Chinese People's Liberation Army

evidence.summary: CASI describes the National Defense University in Beijing as the PLA’s only comprehensive joint command university for senior professional education. It was formed in 1986 by merging the PLA’s military, political and logistics colleges, absorbed several more PLA and People’s Armed Police colleges in 2017, and trains senior commanders from every service and the People’s Armed Police as well as senior central and provincial officials and foreign officers; its key laboratories include a war simulation laboratory and a wargaming centre laboratory.

CASI reports that the university is directly subordinate to the Central Military Commission; it held military-region-leader grade from its founding until 2018, when it was lowered to theatre-command deputy leader.
